name: ROSA
description: ROSA (Robotic Surgical Assistant) is Zimmer Biomet's platform for robotic-assisted orthopedic surgery, including knee procedures. It provides preoperative planning, intraoperative navigation, and robotic guidance to improve precision and reproducibility in joint replacement.

videos.title: Dr. Sebastian Rodriguez-Elizalde - 1000 Cases Utilizing ROSA® Robotic Technology at Humber
